title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move saveConflict and listLiveMetadataTypes out of protocol.ts, each into its own module (#25467 cut 24)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 24 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–23 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939, #25972, #26014, #26104, #26168, #26264, #26317, #26350, #26366, #26404, #26449 and #26654. The claim is `6441745164`. It takes the cut 24 proposal of the cut 23 report (`6440919239`). As the claim orders, the two members are not one theme, so each moves into its own module. Both passed the AST screen and the read-seam census, and both moved unedited.

Two `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited, each into a new module (#23050 shape B):

- `saveConflict` → `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-conflict.ts`: the optimistic-save conflict answer. It builds the save door's 409 for a `ConflictError` through the one conflict builder and writes its decision-audit row (#21207, #23406).
- `listLiveMetadataTypes` → `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-live-metadata-types.ts`: the live metadata-type listing. It returns the engine SchemaRegistry's types plus the `metadata` service's, de-duplicated (#6992).

`protocol.ts` loses 13 net lines (29,165 to 29,152). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread. It was restarted from `main` `fe53769a8e` (cut 23's merge). It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `34b0e4a3c9` and one merge of `main`, `f430c6a947` (8 commits). The merge touches no file of `packages/metadata-protocol/`. The package's `src/` tree is `917e56be` at the move commit and at the merge.

## Serial with the file's in-flight PRs

Measured just before this PR was opened, against the merged head `f430c6a947`: of the 16 open PRs, **none edits `protocol.ts`**, and none names either member or either new module. Three touch `packages/metadata-protocol/src/` test files: **#26337** (3 files, among them `protocol.recovery-doors-emit-mutation.test.ts`), **#26628** (`protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts`) and **#26701** (`protocol.metadata-store-outage.test.ts`). Each one's `git merge-tree` is clean against this head. #26628's test drives `getMetaTypes`, so `listLiveMetadataTypes` runs through the class method there. It stubs `getRegisteredTypes` and does not read `protocol.ts` by path.

`main` moved one commit after the merge: #26682 (`4373103165`, auth sign-out). It touches no file of this package, `git merge-tree` with this head is clean, and the derivation found nothing stale, so `main` was not merged again.

## The order's screen (private statics, `new Error(`, the read-seam census)

Both members passed:

- **No private-static read.** The AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor`.
- **No error constructed.** Neither body has `new Error(`. `saveConflict` returns the refusal that `metadataConflictRefusal` builds. No `PRODUCERS` row is owed.
- **Read-seam census.** `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` was taken on the base and again on the cut: `82 read seam(s)` and an identical list once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped. The full readings are under "The durability `--list`".

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) | New module |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `listLiveMetadataTypes` | `:8494` | private | 15 | 105 | `protocol-live-metadata-types.ts` (66 lines) |
| `saveConflict` | `:21469` | private | 16 | 163 | `protocol-save-conflict.ts` (68 lines) |

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–23 apply it)

- **The class keeps both members.** Each keeps its name, docblock, signature and position. Each body now delegates, marked `[#25467 cut 24]`.
- **`saveConflict` reads two members, both methods.** `SaveConflictHost` types each as the class member itself (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['…']`). The function types its `this` as their `Pick`, and the stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType<typeof saveConflict>`. `metadataConflictRefusal` and `recordOptimisticConflictAudit` are handed over as closures, so the body's calls reach the class methods exactly as before.
- **`listLiveMetadataTypes` reads two members, both fields.** `LiveMetadataTypesHost` types them the same way. `engine` (a `private` field) and `getServicesRegistry` (the constructor-supplied optional function field) are handed over as getters. This is the hand-over cut 20 used for `getServicesRegistry`. So the body reads the protocol's own values at call time, and the `?.()` on an absent registry behaves as before.
- **No member changes visibility.**
- **Every caller still calls the class method.** `getMetaTypes`' `this.listLiveMetadataTypes()` (`:8513`, base) does not change, and neither do the save door's two `throw await this.saveConflict(err, request, writeSource)` sites (`:21243`, `:21454`).

## Module-level declarations, by reader

Measured by an AST walk over each body's identifiers, against `protocol.ts`'s top-level declarations and import bindings (property names excluded):

| Name | Where `protocol.ts` has it | Other readers in `protocol.ts` | What this cut does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ConflictError` (type position, `saveConflict`'s parameter) | the `@objectstack/metadata-core` import | yes (7: five `instanceof` sites, among them the save door's two, `metadataConflictRefusal`'s parameter and the stub's signature) | stays; the new module imports it as a type from there too |

`listLiveMetadataTypes`' body reads no module-level declaration. Its module imports nothing but the class's type. No import of `protocol.ts` loses its last reader, and no declaration gains `export`.

**The `:172` comment is not touched.** The claim allowed correcting the stale `[commit ece4dad31]` emitted-specifier comment (disclosed in cut 23) if this cut touched that import block. This cut adds its two imports after cut 23's import and does not touch the `@objectstack/spec` block, so the comment stays for a later edit.

## The durability `--list`

`check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output: `82 read seam(s)` at both ends. Its `--list` is **identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped** (158 lines, and no entry changes file).

- `listLiveMetadataTypes` has a `try` around the `metadata` service's `getRegisteredTypes()`. That callee is outside the gate's read vocabulary (`find`/`findOne`/`count`), so the catch was not a read seam before the move and is not one after it.
- `saveConflict` has no `try`.
- On the merged tree the verdict still reads `82 read seam(s)`.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`: sorted-union identity, measured first, with raw identity reported when it holds. **Both hold for this cut.**

Base `fe53769a8e` and head `34b0e4a3c9` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree. The closure was built at head by a full `pnpm build` (116/116). For the base build, the package's `src/` was swapped tree-only to base (both new modules removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap. Afterwards `git diff HEAD` was empty, `git status` was clean, and all three touched blobs equalled `HEAD`'s.

- **Normalised sha256** (the ruling's bar): `310d157f1455a7b76c3d9a60e905ac5e07debb23ec4a6a615b510870341bdbec` at both ends, on `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`. The normaliser sorted 80 string-literal union runs. **Sorted-union identity holds.**
- **Raw sha256**: `724eaa784128c37a7e4b59d85e21212ba6378a5b07279853c97828cd8368e932` at both ends, 777,143 bytes. **Raw identity holds.**
- **Again on the merged tree** `f430c6a947` (closure rebuilt by a full `pnpm build`, 116/116): the same raw and normalised sha256, and the same `index.js`/`index.cjs` hashes, as the pre-merge head.
- **The two builds differ where they should.**
  - `index.js` hashes `8cc705b2d0a6a59b…` at base and `0cb9bc1754636851…` at head (`index.cjs` `8af96d570232787c…` → `40c568bf03d0672b…`).
  - `listLiveMetadataTypes.call(host` and `saveConflict.call(host` each occur 0 times in the base bundles and once in the head bundles (ESM and CJS alike).
  - `function listLiveMetadataTypes(` and `function saveConflict(` each go 0 → 1.
- **Positive control** on the head tree. `private` was dropped from `saveConflict` on disk (restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `980c4b207280c4e8…` (normalised `f5a4a75faae310fd…`, which differs from the bar's `310d157f…`). So the bar can see a change on these members.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head. The sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all of them. Neither moved function nor either `…Host` interface appears.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Proof of move-only

**Bodies, by AST token.** The compare reads the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, with JSDoc skipped, over the parameters (less the added `this`), the return type and the body. It compares base `protocol.ts` at `fe53769a8e` against the two head modules:

```
listLiveMetadataTypes: base tokens 105, head tokens 105, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
saveConflict: base tokens 163, head tokens 163, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=268 differ=0 members=2
CLASS members base=301 head=301 order-same=true byte-identical=299 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=2 other=[]
TOP base=252 head=254 byte-identical=252
```

**Negative controls**, one per member. Each changed one token in an in-memory copy of a head module:

```
MUTATED packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-live-metadata-types.ts "getRegisteredTypes()" -> "getRegisteredTypez()"
listLiveMetadataTypes: base tokens 105, head tokens 105, differ 1, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) false
saveConflict: base tokens 163, head tokens 163, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
MUTATED packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-conflict.ts "return conflict;" -> "return err;"
listLiveMetadataTypes: base tokens 105, head tokens 105, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
saveConflict: base tokens 163, head tokens 163, differ 1, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) false
```

- **Class side.** There are 301 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 299 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. Both stubs sit at their base positions and keep their docblocks and signatures byte-identical.
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** All 252 base statements are byte-identical, leading comments included. Head adds two statements, the new modules' imports.
- **Size.** +152 / −31 over 3 files, 183 changed lines.

## Readers of the moved lines

The tests and scripts that read `protocol.ts` by path (the files that name `protocol.ts` and call `readFileSync`) were grepped for both member names and for the bodies' text: `metadataConflictRefusal`, `recordOptimisticConflictAudit`, `has been modified since you loaded it`, `schemaTypes`, `runtimeTypes`, `MetadataService not available`. So were the test files in `packages/`, `docs/qa/` and the `@objectstack/spec` liveness ledgers.

- **By path: none reads the moved bodies.** Of the 26 such files, the one textual hit is a `// MetadataService not available` comment inside an inline fixture of `scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs`. That fixture is its own code string and does not read `protocol.ts`.
- **By name, outside the package:** `packages/spec/src/meta-spelling/metadata-url-spelling.ts` names `listLiveMetadataTypes()` in a comment only. No edit is owed.
- **The liveness ledgers.** No row points at either member. Carried forward: `manifest.json`'s `dependencies` row → `protocol.ts#resolveWritePackageScope` (cut 19), and `seed.json` → `protocol.ts#applySeedBodies` (cut 14). Both still quote lines that moved to a seam module. `check:liveness` checks only that the `#symbol` is named in the file, and both stubs keep it. Re-pointing them is a `packages/spec/**` edit, outside this card.
- **ADR anchors.** `check-adr-anchors` gives identical output at both ends: 1,871 decision-letter citations, and 59,671 citations across 8,363 files. Neither moved body cites an ADR. `listLiveMetadataTypes`' docblock (ADR-0131 D6) stays on the stub, and neither new module's header cites one.
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends.
  - The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (13866 → 13863, 13891 → 13888).
  - `productionFiles` is 3,777 at base and 3,780 at head. The +3 are the two new files and the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` that the spec build writes in the head tree, as in cuts 20–23.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-anchors`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity` and `check-durability-degradation-log-level`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +2. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `fe53769a8e`.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 at head and on the merged tree.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 with no output (the whole touched package, with the root `lint` script's flags).
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, base and head, compared per test name and status. Each leg ran vitest `--maxWorkers=2` with the JSON reporter under the shared verify lock.
  - Base `fe53769a8e`: 21,599 tests (21,580 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 272 files.
  - Head `34b0e4a3c9`: 21,599 tests (21,580 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 272 files.
  - None lost, none added, none changed status. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `fe53769a8e` (both new modules removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
  - The merged head `f430c6a947` gives the same 21,599 tests, per test identical to the pre-merge head (0 lost, 0 added, 0 changed).
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (merged tree): OK. 1 anchored file is in the change set, 29 anchors were judged, and 0 were lost.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` finds 0 of 3 paths in the register (13 surfaces), so the PR is NOT governed. It has 183 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 46 gates on 3 changed paths from `f430c6a947`, with no stale-tree finding, and all 46 exit 0 after the full `pnpm build` (116/116). `dispatch-gates --ran` reports 46 derived, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED and 0 UNRUN, and exits 0.
- `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` on `f430c6a947`: `82 read seam(s)`.

## Carry-forward

These stay in `protocol.ts`:

- **The read-seam members** (cut 21). A member named in a `protocol.ts` read-seam entry of `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list`, as the guarded wrapper or the guarding member, stays until the gate follows imported wrappers or a ruling accepts the loss. The census-negative set is the one cuts 22–23 measured (this cut re-trialled only its own members and the cut 25 candidates): `findEnvironmentRows`, `packagelessAddress`, `findServedOverlayRow`, `foldStoredCollection`, `applyObjectRegistryMutation`, `unmanagedImportCollisions`, `rollBackUnmanagedImport`, `readRevertableCommit` and `storedFlowBindingAgrees`. `rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned` cannot move at all.
- Public members whose return type is inferred.
- **The bodies kept by a by-path reader:**
  - `probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType` and `metaTypeNamespaceExists`.
  - `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, and `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`.
  - The 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers (among them `applyRemoteMetadataMutation`), `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` and `ensureObjectStorage`.
  - `emitMetadataMutation`: its body is one of the two `this.notifyMutationListenersLocal(` sites that `protocol.recovery-doors-emit-mutation.test.ts` counts in `protocol.ts`.
- The private-static readers: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`.
- The field writers: `warnClosureReadUnavailable`.
